_doc: mk-196 Deep House (Arulo, Mixkit), 123.996 BPM, G minor vamp, stretched 3.2 % to 120. Downbeats at (n-1) x 1.935546 s in the source (kick-band fit; arrange.py locked onto the off-beat hats, half a beat out). The harmony is one static chord, so the single splice is harmonically clean (chroma similarity 0.92). The film loops: segment 3 (src bar 7) ends exactly where segment 1 (src bar 8) begins.

segments.label: src bars 8-12 -> film bars 1-5: the last sparse intro bar under the opening typing, the groove (kick + bass, +6 dB low band) enters on film 2.0 with the cascade

src bars 40-44 -> film bars 6-10: bar 40 brings the hats back (lift into the QR), bar 41 is the break (kick, bass and highs out) under the confetti typing, bar 42 returns full on 14.0 = Make Confetti, stop after the downbeat of src bar 44 (film 18.0) with a short tail so the last letters land in near-silence
src bar 7 -> film 22.0-24.0: the sparse intro bar returns under the pull-out and flows across the loop seam into src bar 8 at film 0.0, so the music never restarts
